issues.description: Ingredient name examples use inconsistent capitalization between the problem statement and the provided code examples. The problem statement shows ingredients in lowercase (e.g., "beans", "bacon", "potatoes"), while the Main examples in the template and solution use capitalized names (e.g., "Bacon", "Sausage", "Vegetables"). Because the code compares ingredient names using exact String equality, this mismatch can confuse students about which literal names to use and whether ingredient matching is case-sensitive.
issues.suggestedFix: Standardize ingredient name examples across artifacts to use the same capitalization (e.g., use "Bacon", "Sausage", "Vegetables" everywhere or use lowercase everywhere), or explicitly document that ingredient matching is case-sensitive and advise students to follow the exact literal names used in the Stock. Update problem_statement.md and the Main examples accordingly.
